params.caption: 🔥 Phrasal verb of the day: PUT OFF 📖 Meaning: to delay doing something until later; postpone 🇺🇿 Tarjima: keyinga qoldirmoq, kechiktirmoq ✍️ Examples: 1️⃣ I keep putting off my IELTS essay practice. 😅 IELTS esse mashqimni doim keyinga qoldiryapman. 2️⃣ The meeting has been put off until Friday. Uchrashuv jumagacha qoldirildi. 3️⃣ Don’t put it off — start today! 💪 Uni keyinga qoldirma — bugun boshla! 💡 Tip: fe'l -ing bilan keladi: put off doing ✅ (put off to do ❌). Olmosh esa o'rtada turadi: put it off ✅ (put off it ❌). 🎯 Speaking'da sinonim sifatida ishlating: postpone, delay. #PhrasalVerbs #EnglishTips #IELTS #RegistanAcademy 📌 https://registan.edutizim.uz/order/entry/?survey=s33 📞 +998935512700 📱 Follow us on social media: 📱Telegram 📱Instagram 📱Location
